# Isaiah Chapter 35 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 153r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_035_page_001.jpg

---

**35:1** The-wilderness [midbar] and-the-dry-land [tsiyyah] will-be-glad [yessusum]; and-the-desert [aravah] will-rejoice [tagel] and-blossom [tifrach] like-the-crocus [ka-chavatstselet].

**35:5** Then the-eyes of-the-blind [ivrim] will-be-opened [tippaqachnah], and-the-ears of-the-deaf [chereshim] will-be-unstopped [tippatachnah]. **35:6** Then the-lame [pisseach] will-leap [yedlleg] like-a-deer [ka-ayyal], and-the-tongue [leshon] of-the-mute [illem] will-sing [taronnen]; for waters [mayim] will-break-out [nivqe'u] in-the-wilderness, and-streams [nechalim] in-the-desert.

**35:10** And-the-ransomed [u-feduyei] of-YHWH will-return [yeshuvun] and-come [u-va'u] to-Tsiyon with-singing [be-rinnah]; and-everlasting [olam] joy [simchat] [will be] upon their-heads [rosham]; gladness [sason] and-joy [simchah] they-will-obtain [yasssigu], and-sorrow [yagon] and-sighing [va-anachah] will-flee-away [venasu].

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**v.1 — "the wilderness will be glad":** Isaiah 35 is the counterpart to ch.34's judgment. Where ch.34 describes Edom becoming wilderness, ch.35 describes wilderness becoming paradise. The blind see, the deaf hear, the lame leap — this is the total restoration of creation.

**v.10 — "the ransomed of YHWH":** This verse reappears verbatim in Isaiah 51:11. The image of return with singing — sorrow and sighing fleeing — is the emotional climax of the chapter.

*— PNEUMA*
